purpose: Document local registry evidence and public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The local ATR/BPN office confirms parcel-boundary inspection and land-right processing in Mataram. Official city SIMTARU serves spatial-planning and zoning functions, not cadastral parcels. BHUMI documentation describes the national map platform, but public WFS GetCapabilities and DescribeFeatureType requests to its `umum:Persil` proxy returned HTTP 403; no geometry was queried or retained.
registryAssessment: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Mataram (ATR/BPN) publishes city-specific field-inspection work involving plot boundaries and land-title processing, establishing a local registry/procedure. The article concerns a different kelurahan and does not prove WUP-point parcel coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city land-office article describes field inspection of plot boundaries and land-right processing in Mataram; no geometry is published in the article.
Official Mataram City spatial-planning system offers RTRW/RDTR and zoning/planning maps; these are not cadastral parcel geometry.
Official BHUMI help page describes the public interactive national land/spatial map platform; it does not establish Mataram-specific feature coverage.

officialPrimarySources.method: WFS GetCapabilities and DescribeFeatureType; schema-first metadata check
officialPrimarySources.observation: Both public metadata requests returned HTTP 403. No WFS feature query or geometry request followed.
